name: AUTHORS
description: Authors is a classic memory-based card game where players compete to collect complete sets (books) of four cards of the same rank. Unlike 'Go Fish,' where players ask for a whole rank, Authors requires the precision of asking for a specific card by both rank and suit. It rewards keen observation and a sharp memory of which cards have been requested and by whom.

content.text: Authors is a classic memory-based card game where players compete to collect complete sets (books) of four cards of the same rank. Unlike 'Go Fish,' where players ask for a whole rank, Authors requires the precision of asking for a specific card by both rank and suit. It rewards keen observation and a sharp memory of which cards have been requested and by whom.

Originally published in 1861 by G.M. Whipple and A.A. Smith in Salem, Massachusetts. The original set featured cards with names of famous authors and their book titles (e.g., Charles Dickens and 'Oliver Twist').
Standard pack, score sheet for counting books.
The entire deck is dealt out as evenly as possible. Some players may have one more card than others.

items.text: Go Fish Style: Played with a stock (boneyard). If the player doesn't have the card, you 'fish' from the deck.
Literature: A much more complex version played in teams where you ask for ranks from teammates and opponents.
